A band of minotaurs hides objects stolen from the dwarves in their tower west of Kazordoon. Enter through the secret hideout, climb the {wiki:Minotaur Tower|Minotaur Tower} fighting Minotaur Guards, Archers and Mages, and collect a {item:Steel Helmet}, two piles of coins and the scroll {item:The Fox Is Out (Book)|The Fox Is Out}.
